% f09_omega variant b -- the same 39 ratios, sorted by ratio instead of by N.
% Data: figures/omega_by_instance.tex (generated by scripts/gen_figures.py from
%   /home/rohit/sprs-fix/data/results/live_hw_results_p1_maxpe.csv, max-over-PEs).
%   The minimum is \SlackBest{} (macro \SlackBest, data/results_macros.tex), which
%   is the value the text quotes. The median, 2.34, is the median of exactly the
%   39 ratios plotted here.
% Strategy: rank order rather than N on the x-axis. This makes the SHAPE of the
%   spread the subject -- roughly half the suite sits below 2.4x and a short tail
%   carries the rest -- and puts the \SlackBest{} minimum at a fixed, labelled
%   endpoint instead of leaving the reader to find it among the leftmost points.
% Target: IEEE single column, 3.5in = 8.9cm. Drawn at 8.6cm.
% Topology hues, identical to f08 and f09a (shared palette).
\colorlet{ctorus}{spBlue}
\colorlet{cfattree}{spVerm}
\colorlet{chypercube}{spGreen}
\colorlet{cring}{spPurple}
\colorlet{cmesh}{spAmber}
\colorlet{clinear}{spInk}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
  width=8.6cm, height=6.2cm,
  xlabel={instances, sorted by $\mathrm{cycles}/\Omega$},
  ylabel={champion cycles $/\ \Omega$},
  xmin=0, xmax=40.5, ymin=1.0, ymax=9.9,
  xtick={1,10,20,30,39},
  ytick={1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9},
  tick label style={font=\scriptsize, text=spInk},
  label style={font=\scriptsize, text=spInk},
  grid=major, major grid style={spGrid, very thin},
  legend style={font=\tiny, at={(0.03,0.97)}, anchor=north west,
                legend columns=3, draw=spMute, fill=white,
                fill opacity=0.9, text opacity=1, column sep=2pt,
                row sep=0.5pt, inner sep=2pt},
  mark options={scale=0.8},
  clip=false,
]
\addplot[only marks, mark=*, ctorus] coordinates {
  (4,1.495) (12,1.969) (13,2) (14,2.083) (17,2.229) (18,2.3) (29,3.875)
  (31,4.13) (36,6.861) (39,9.068)};
\addlegendentry{torus}
\addplot[only marks, mark=square*, cfattree] coordinates {
  (10,1.833) (20,2.34) (23,3.188) (24,3.333) (26,3.458) (28,3.812)
  (33,4.583) (38,8.043)};
\addlegendentry{fat-tree}
\addplot[only marks, mark=triangle*, chypercube] coordinates {
  (5,1.552) (7,1.771) (8,1.812) (11,1.854) (15,2.111) (25,3.375) (27,3.604)};
\addlegendentry{hypercube}
\addplot[only marks, mark=diamond*, cring] coordinates {
  (19,2.333) (22,3.077) (32,4.159) (34,4.81) (35,4.969) (37,7.095)};
\addlegendentry{ring}
\addplot[only marks, mark=pentagon*, cmesh] coordinates {
  (6,1.625) (16,2.167) (21,3) (30,4.062)};
\addlegendentry{mesh}
\addplot[only marks, mark=x, mark size=2.2pt, line width=0.8pt, clinear] coordinates {
  (1,1.349) (2,1.38) (3,1.398) (9,1.833)};
\addlegendentry{linear}
% median of the 39 plotted ratios
\addplot[spMute, dashed, thick, domain=0:40.5, samples=2, forget plot] {2.34};
\node[font=\tiny, anchor=west, text=spMute, inner sep=1.5pt, fill=white,
      fill opacity=0.85, text opacity=1] at (axis cs:29.2,2.34) {median $2.34$};
% the minimum
\draw[spGreen, thin] (axis cs:1,1.349) -- (axis cs:4.6,1.13);
\node[font=\tiny, anchor=west, inner sep=1.5pt, text=spGreen] at (axis cs:4.6,1.13)
  {minimum $\SlackBest\times$};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
